description: Rules from spec/01-identity.md, including digest checks against real fixture files.

vectors.name: identity/artifact-required
vectors.description: Without 'artifact' there is no identity at all.

vectors.name: identity/digest-format
vectors.description: Digests are sha256 followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

vectors.name: identity/digest-matches-fixture
vectors.description: The digest of fixtures/hello.txt is the one the record declares.

vectors.name: identity/digest-mismatch
vectors.description: The record claims hello.txt but is checked against other.txt.

vectors.name: identity/size-mismatch
vectors.description: A size that disagrees with the file is a false claim about the artifact.

vectors.name: identity/size-non-negative
vectors.description: A negative length is not a length.

vectors.name: identity/media-type-syntax
vectors.description: A media type without a subtype does not follow RFC 2046.

vectors.name: identity/id-format
vectors.description: The identifier is a urn in the variorum namespace, over sha256.

vectors.name: identity/id-derived-from-digest
vectors.description: A well-formed identifier that disagrees with the digest is a lie about which bytes this is.

vectors.name: identity/producer-requires-name
vectors.description: An actor without a name identifies nobody.

vectors.name: identity/producer-kind-vocabulary
vectors.description: Producer kinds are human, organization or software.

vectors.name: identity/software-producer-name-recommended
vectors.description: Naming the software is a SHOULD (ID-12); omitting it must not invalidate the record.

vectors.name: identity/producer-accepted
vectors.description: A complete producer object is valid and does not affect identity.
